<a name="cancel"></a>

## cancel(element) ⇒ <code>boolean</code>
Cancel an animation or pending replacement. An already-running swap callback
cannot be aborted; its eventual completion will not start a stale entrance.

**Kind**: global function<br>
**Returns**: <code>boolean</code> - Whether an animation or replacement was cancelled.<br>
**Throws**:

- <code>TypeError</code> When the target is not a supported element.


| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| element | <code>HTMLElement</code> \| <code>SVGElement</code> | Motion shell. |
